_about: The opening probe's settings (companion/open_probe.py, briefs 09, 21 and 23). Times are ET, weekdays only. It reads Schwab quotes and previews Break orders; it never sends an order. At each preview time it previews a long and a short Break order for one pick, the next in rank order each time (SPY without picks), built at 1 share by the ticket's builders and copied to preview_shares for the preview only. It writes the requirement rate from the poller's last balances, never a balance in dollars, and hands each preview line to the Opening plan's rate store (companion/preview_rates.py). The two windows before 09:25 (brief 23) preview the plan's preview picks, so each name's rate is known before the freeze; the 09:26:30 window covers the locked picks. quote_every_s, the windows, the preview times, preview_shares and the two caps are start numbers, not approved by Ash.
